title: Group in Swimwear on Boulder, River Canyon - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vertical vintage black-and-white snapshot depicting a group of people in swimwear perched atop a large boulder beside a deep swimming hole or river canyon. The steep, rocky hillside behind them is dotted with sparse brush and evergreen trees. A bright photographic light leak flare extends from the lower right edge into the dark water, typical of early roll-film box cameras. The photograph captures the carefree spirit of summertime recreation during the 1930s.
